task_specification.objective: Make both active issues closure-ready in this loop by repairing authored cemetery spatial integrity and completing the ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper lifecycle, while satisfying the required readable upgrade-choice capability.

diagnosis.root_cause: The shipped high-angle camera still loses the cracked bell and escape lanes, while the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper route remains unverified. Prior camera treatments repeatedly tuned transforms; the next repair should instead rebind the authored world/camera contract and harden authoritative route transitions.

stop_conditions: Stop after the two bounded implementation clusters have focused code checks and are ready for host/Tester recapture.
Do not add deferred shell, onboarding, dense-profile, MCP-rebind, or unrelated asset-replacement work.

strategy.rationale: Change root-cause strategy from repeated camera transform tuning to a single authored-package plus outer-datum rebind for visibility, collision, perimeter, and external depth, alongside authoritative wave/run-state transition repair with an explicit player-facing upgrade decision contract.

code: Run focused Godot script/resource checks on both task file clusters; verify no parse errors, broken NodePaths, missing resources, or invalid signal/state references.
Run preserved native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks after edits; ensure the required camera_movement_dash and wave_director_boss phase checks are available for recapture.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture spatial cells: fresh spawn, ordinary movement and dash, four cardinal interior-street views, central landmark approach from every side, cracked-bell near contact/departure, and full perimeter/boundary traversal; verify collision, larger traversable scale, external depth, disappearance/occlusion, and stable escape lanes.

Host/Tester recapture route cells: execute an ordinary run through Waves 1–5, observe composition/elite escalation and timers, capture Bellkeeper request plus both phases/telegraphs/recovery, defeat or fail, then verify exactly-once terminal Result and clean Retry/replay.

Host/Tester inspect the upgrade draft on the rendered page at the target resolution with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad-equivalent focus; compare visible visual hierarchy, silhouettes or icons, current-to-new values, bounded deltas, and authoritative selected-build state. Tester owns final issue closure and phase verdicts.
visual: Use the bound cemetery gameplay reference as the composition check: moonlit blue-violet shadows, warm landmark lights, readable Warden/threat silhouettes, cracked bell and mausoleum separation, escape-lane readability, and layered external cemetery depth.

Inspect wave/boss and Result/Retry transition frames for clear state ownership, readable boss telegraphs/health/phases, and an icon-led visual hierarchy without clipping, overlap, or placeholder CURRENT values.

done_when: The authored arena uses a larger traversable scale (or a measurable expand change) sized for sustained traversal, and its external world/external depth remains visible beyond the playable boundary at multiple perimeter edges.
Four cardinal first-person views from an interior native street keep the Warden, cracked bell, central building/landmark, nearby threats, and at least one escape lane readable.

The central building/landmark and cracked bell have collision aligned to their visible footprints; ordinary movement/movement replay around every side cannot pass through, fall outside the boundary/perimeter, or reveal a void.

No landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift occurs before approach, at near contact, or after departure; selective fade is limited to registered sight blockers and never hides the whole gameplay landmark.
Camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, dash anticipation/onset/recovery, cooldown, invulnerability, and clean pause/resume remain intact without FPS/TPS drift.
Focused spatial/static checks pass with no parse, missing-node, or resource errors; host can directly retest spawn, landmark near-contact, departure, and perimeter traversal.
tasks.instructions: Repair the real authored world and camera owners, not another isolated transform tweak. Rebind the intact cemetery package, outer datum, player/objective anchors, navigation, collision, and camera visibility query in one transform space; expand the playable datum if needed for the seven-to-ten-minute traversal and preserve a coherent non-playable external world beyond its boundary. Reconcile the mausoleum and cracked-bell visible footprints with StaticBody3D collision and registered occluder handling, retaining sight lanes and the high-angle arena-readable camera. Preserve native map assets and avoid splitting, replacing, or surgically editing the authored package.

done_when: An ordinary run advances through all five data-driven waves in contiguous order with warmup, active pressure, intermission/draft pause, and reset-safe clocks; live enemy caps, spawn budgets, safe approach lanes, and composition escalation are honored.

Wave 5 requests the Bellkeeper exactly once after ordinary completion, and the boss presents two readable phases with telegraph, summon or lane-pressure behavior, and a vulnerable recovery window among the crowd.
Boss defeat commits victory exactly once; no further spawning, attacks, damage, or rewards mutate the terminal state, and Result then Retry starts a clean run with no stale boss/enemy/UI/audio state.

The upgrade draft uses a clear visual hierarchy with silhouettes or icons as the first anchor. Three authored choices show compact icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, never NEW or LOCKED in the CURRENT value, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed states; the selected id/rank/modifier is applied before.

Keep ordinary movement and spawn safety supplied by the spatial repair. In the same release decision boundary, implement the upgrade-draft choice hierarchy with a clear visual hierarchy: each card leads with silhouettes or icons, exposes truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, excludes NEW or LOCKED placeholders from CURRENT values, and provides complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states rather than prose-stacked choices.
